maya_kukulkan.name: Xul festival at Maní
maya_kukulkan.notes: Landa describes fasting, procession, feather banners, new fire and offerings beginning on 16 Xul; Maní continued the festival after Mayapan’s destruction.

sources.reference: Landa, Relacion de las cosas de Yucatan, section XL, Xul festival, Gates translation pp. 74–75
